title: Per-module Mayer--Vietoris gluing of flat counit presentations
statement: Let p:Y -> B be quasi-compact and quasi-separated, B and A affine, and g:A -> B. For opens U,V and a relatively flat quasi-coherent module N on (U union V), if StandardSingleFlatCounitOnOpen holds for U, V and U intersect V, then StandardSingleFlatCounitPresentation holds for N on U union V.

proof.text: Restrict N to U, V and U intersect V, destructure the supplied presentations, lift the restriction-difference arrow over the affine base, and form its shifted cone. Mayer--Vietoris and naturality of the counit give the required presentation equation; finite sums and cones preserve bounded flatness.

theorem standardSingleFlatCounitPresentation_union_of_open_presentations
    {Y B A : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ B) [QuasiCompact p] [QuasiSeparated p]
    [IsAffine B] [IsAffine A] (g : A ⟶ B) (U V : Y.Opens)
    (N : (U ⊔ V).toScheme.Modules) [N.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hN : N.IsFlatOver ((U ⊔ V).ι ≫ p))
    (hPU : StandardSingleFlatCounitOnOpen p g U)
    (hPV : StandardSingleFlatCounitOnOpen p g V)
    (hPUV : StandardSingleFlatCounitOnOpen p g (U ⊓ V)) :
    StandardSingleFlatCounitPresentation ((U ⊔ V).ι ≫ p) N g
